description: Airly provides access to accurate, hyper-local data about air pollution through a SaaS solution that combines a network of sensors, corporate functions and services to reduce air pollution worldwide.

Constellr uses cutting-edge beyond-visual imaging technology to revolutionise the way we assess crucial aspects of our planet’s health. With temperature readings, Constellr are able to monitor vegetation, soil health, and derive insights on water and carbon as well as monitor industrial activities with an unprecedented level of accuracy.
Defined.ai is a provider of high-quality training data and an overarching infrastructure of solutions for artificial intelligence, all focusing on making AI smarter.
EMOTAI has developed a headband and platform that boosts performance through bio-signal tracking and training designed to help increase focus and critical thinking skills.
Fero is a fintech platform providing working capital and stock management software built specifically for the wine and spirits industry.
Flecto is the platform for any company to thrive in the access economy. The company is simplifying access through a platform that manages rental operations and provides multiple channels.

Gigaton develops AI-powered decarbonisation technology for cement production. Its solution is specifically designed for the cement pyroprocess and leverages the latest advances in machine learning to identify energy inefficiencies, reduce costs, and lower carbon emissions.

GROPYUS advances the development of sustainable buildings. The company transform the construction industry through technology by looking at homes as products to create truly sustainable and affordable buildings. Sustainability permeates every step of the building process: design, production, construction, and asset management.

JUPUS is the AI secretariat for lawyers. With JUPUS, hundreds of law firms automate every work step every day, from the client’s first phone call to the finished legal document – completing hour-long tasks in seconds.

Kencko is a smart food company, reinventing organic fruit and vegetable products to help people eat healthier and waste less. The only ingredients the company uses are whole organic plant foods, which are flash-frozen and slow-dried to retain their fiber and nutrients.

LOQR is a key enabler that helps banks accelerate their digital transformation process by providing a customer-centric platform that allows banks to offer faster, easier, and compliant services and experiences to their customers.
Oceano Fresco is a sustainable seafood company using innovative aquaculture techniques to grow high-quality bivalve species.
Overstory applies machine learning to satellite imagery, which creates insights about the quantity and quality of forests and other natural resources to improve decision making for utility companies.

Probely is a cloud-based application security testing solution designed to empower Security and DevOps teams to work efficiently together on a DevSecOps approach built to reduce risk across web applications and RESTful APIs.
Realfevr is a web3 startup building an ambitious gamified and immersive ecosystem around licensed sports digital collectibles.

Sonant is an AI-powered receptionist platform specifically designed for insurance agencies, brokers, and distributors. The technology automates client communication processes, handling tasks such as appointment scheduling, call routing, and information collection for insurance quotes.
Soveren is a sensitive data observability company with a mission to help leading organizations protect millions of consumer data records without slowing down their business.
Spoke is a delivery software powering the next generation of delivery companies by making the last-mile experience faster, easier, and less stressful for all.
